home.title: SSSUI · Semantic search engine
home.lead: Your documents become vectors in a shared embedding space. Ask a question in natural language — the engine finds the nearest passages, reranks them and writes an answer grounded in your sources.
home.pipeline_title: From raw files to grounded answers
home.pipeline_lead: Every collection runs the same retrieval-augmented pipeline on the engine side.
home.stage_chunk_text: Text is cleaned, denoised and split into overlapping token windows.
home.stage_embed_text: Each chunk becomes a dense vector stored in an IVF / HNSW index.
home.stage_rerank_text: Nearest neighbours of your query are re-scored by a cross-encoder.
home.stage_generate_text: An LLM summarises the top passages into an answer you can rate.
home.feature_collection_text: Pick the embedder, the re-ranker and the vector index that fit your knowledge base.
home.feature_upload_text: Upload PDF, DOCX, TXT, HTML, MD or ZIP files and tune chunk size and overlap.
home.feature_search_text: Filter by category or document, rerank results and generate grounded answers.
